myKeys.title: My API Keys
myKeys.emptyTitle: You don't have any keys yet
myKeys.emptyHint: You need a key to call the company AI from your favorite AI tool.
myKeys.helpTitle: What is a key? What is a virtual model?
myKeys.helpBody: A key is like a 'keycard' for calling the company AI. A virtual model is a unified model name the company prepares for you (e.g. 'Company Main'), backed by several real models — if one goes down, it auto-switches to another.
myKeys.helpFillName: This is the name you fill in your AI tool
myKeys.helpPlaceholder: — fill in company-chat, you just fill in company-chat,
myKeys.helpNoNeedToKnow: you don't need to know whether it's GPT or Claude behind the scenes
myKeys.applyDialogDesc: The admin will configure available models and quota based on your purpose, usually approved within 1 business day.
myKeys.purposePlaceholder: Purpose description: e.g. Q4 business travel, need AI to draft proposals
myKeys.applyAlertTitle: The request content will be copied to the clipboard after submission
myKeys.applyAlertDesc: Just paste it to the admin (or send it via WeCom) — no need to type the purpose manually.
myKeys.applyCopied: Request content copied. Paste it to the admin to submit.
myKeys.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please note the request content manually.
myKeys.purposeRequired: Please fill in the purpose description
myKeys.applyTextTemplate: Hi, I need a new API key. Purpose: {purpose}. Please help me set it up and let me know the available virtual models and quota.
